_description: All confirmed LIFE Compute hits — molecules with validated Boltz2 affinity scores. Auto-updated by miner on confirmed $LIFE mint.

_fields.smiles: SMILES string of the candidate molecule
_fields.boltz_score: Validated ΔG affinity in kcal/mol (negative = binding; lower = stronger)
_fields.uniprot_id: UniProt accession of the protein target
_fields.miner_wallet: Base58 pubkey of the miner who submitted this hit
_fields.epoch: On-chain epoch number when the result was submitted
_fields.tx: Solana transaction signature of the mint_reward instruction
_fields.timestamp: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the hit was confirmed on-chain
_fields.life_earned: Raw $LIFE tokens minted (6 decimals, divide by 1e6 for display)
